name: Ellie P. Natenberg
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Ellie P. Natenberg is an associate attorney at Fullenweider Wilhite in Houston, Texas. Ms. Natenberg focuses her practice on family law, representing clients in Houston and Austin. She handles cases involving divorce, adoptions, appeals, child support, enforcement of court orders, parental rights, premarital agreements, post-marital agreements, property characterization, property division and property valuation.

Ms. Natenberg has over a decade of legal experience and is board-certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization. Over the course of her career, she has represented clients in many complex family law matters at the trial and appellate levels. Her work has earned her recognition by Houstonia magazine, who named her a “Top Lawyer in Houston” in 2017.

A valuable contributor to her legal community, Ms. Natenberg has lectured for organizations, including the State Bar of Texas, the Texas Center for the Judiciary and the Burta Rhoads Raborn Family Law American Inn of Court. She has also authored articles on family law issues for professional publications.

Active in the Houston Bar Association, Ms. Natenberg belongs to the organization’s Family Law Section and Appellate Practice Section. She is a member of the State Bar of Texas Family Law Section, the Texas Academy of Family Law Specialists, the Gulf Coast Family Law Specialists, and Burta Rhoads Raborn Family Law American Inn of Court and the Iranian American Bar Association.

After graduating from the University of Texas at Austin with a bachelor’s degree, Ms. Natenberg earned her law degree from the University of Houston Law Center. She holds a license to practice law before all Texas state courts.
